label: Ask AI
description: Sends a question or instruction (the prompt) to an AI model and saves its reply. Use {{ state.<field> }} in the prompt to insert data from earlier steps.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The AI model that writes the reply. Plug in an “AI model” block.

outputs.name: next
outputs.description: Where to go after the reply is saved: connect the next step, or Finish.

prompt.title: Instructions for the AI (prompt)
prompt.description: What you want the AI to do. Insert data with {{ state.<field> }}, e.g. Summarize this: {{ state.question }}

output.title: Save the reply in
output.description: The data field that receives the AI's answer. Add fields in the Inspector (click empty canvas).
